title: Check if a number is positive, negative, or zero
description: Choose a number. Use if, elif, and else to check it. Print whether it is positive, negative, or zero.
hints: Read the task once and identify the Python feature it asks you to practise.
Use an if/else decision and print the result.
Write your own code, press Run, and fix any syntax or runtime error shown.
explanation: The first condition checks for a positive number. elif checks for a negative number. else runs when the number is zero.
commonMistakes: Use > 0 for positive and < 0 for negative. Do not group zero with positive numbers.

validation.feedback: Use an if/else decision and print the result.
